roles.EQUAL_PRINCIPAL: Two or more issuers with equal principal causal weight.
roles.SECONDARY_AFFECTED: An issuer genuinely affected downstream but not principal.
roles.CONTEXT_ONLY: An issuer present only as context, comparison, commentary, history, or another non-causal reference.
roles.POSSIBLE_PRINCIPAL: A genuine unresolved ambiguity over principal issuer identity or causality; difficulty alone is insufficient.

completeness_rule: Include every issuer identity required to represent the causal structure, not only the selected issuer, while excluding irrelevant lexical entities.
identity_rule: Store the expected semantic issuer identity supported by frozen adjudication. Do not rewrite truth labels solely to obtain deterministic comparator equivalence; preserve legal-entity, parent/subsidiary, brand/parent, and collision distinctions.
proxy_rule: PRINCIPAL, EQUAL_PRINCIPAL, or POSSIBLE_PRINCIPAL implies zero proxy candidates. With no such issuer, retain exactly the genuinely principal bounded exposures: one permits PROXY, multiple require UNRESOLVED, and none requires an empty set.
projection_rule: Typed labels must project exactly to the frozen v3 mapping through ai-shadow-causal-attribution-c1e-v1 and remain valid under ai-shadow-causal-attribution-validator-c1f-v1.
review_rule: Use two explicit logical passes. Pass 2 reports contradictions and never silently repairs them. Freeze only with zero remaining marking ambiguity and zero contract conflict.
